title: Fischer Zero-Forcing Counterexample
headline: Lean 4 formalisation of Mikko Fischer's 24-vertex zero-forcing counterexample, independently verified by the Palomar Registry.
description: This project formalises Mikko Fischer's explicit 24-vertex connected subcubic counterexample to the zero-forcing-versus-independence conjecture. In Lean 4 it verifies $\alpha(H)=9$ and $Z(H)=11$, so $Z(H)>\alpha(H)+1$; the formalisation has been registered and independently verified by the Palomar Registry. The underlying graph and mathematical counterexample are Fischer's; John Fairfax-Ball's contribution is the formalisation, independent finite reconstruction, auditing and verification packaging.
verification: Registered and independently verified by the Palomar Registry.
attribution: Counterexample and underlying mathematics: Mikko Fischer. Lean 4 formalisation, independent finite reconstruction, audit and Palomar packaging: John Fairfax-Ball.
